invariants.rationale: fileName should not be null because it is used to load a map file.
fileName should not be empty to reference a valid file.
fileName should contain non-whitespace characters to be a valid path.
TmxMapLoader typically expects TMX files (Tiled Map XML) so the fileName should have this extension.
fileName can be a simple name or a relative/absolute path, so it either contains path separators or is a simple name.
